abstract: Validates precision dual-loop climate control and standard vault shelving capacity
system_message:
You are HVAC and Conservation Director (HPC). As the HVAC and Conservation Director (HPC), you validate precision dual-loop climate control and standard vault shelving capacity across candidate disaster recovery repository facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Dew point stabilization testing（HUMID）
information_points.content:
HPC-HUMID-BDB：Environmental logger telemetry indicates that Cheviot Highland Archive Bunker exhibits a relative humidity fluctuation tolerance of 5% in its manuscript storage area.
HPC-HUMID-R3B：Environmental logger telemetry for Cotswold Subterranean Vaults records a relative humidity fluctuation tolerance of 2% across a 30-day baseline in the archival chamber.
HPC-HUMID-LH2：Pennine Deep Rock Repository demonstrated a relative humidity fluctuation tolerance of 8% based on the 30-day archival chamber environmental log.

information_points.title: Validates precision dual-loop climate control and standard vault shelving capacity（ENV）
information_points.content:
HPC-ENV-0H1：Pennine Deep Rock Repository does not have certified climate control redundancy commissioned, while its standard vault shelving capacity is recorded at 4500 m3.
HPC-ENV-B7K：For Cotswold Subterranean Vaults, the mechanical engineering audit confirms certified climate control redundancy is present with an N+1 redundant loop and automatic failover, and the standard vault shelving capacity is 3200 m3 of net usable motorized compact shelving volume.
HPC-ENV-HR1：Cheviot Highland Archive Bunker possesses certified climate control redundancy according to the mechanical engineering audit, and its standard vault shelving capacity measures 5800 m3.
